title: USC Undergraduate Student Government (USG) - Home
text:
USC Undergraduate Student Government (USG) is the official governing body of undergraduate students at the University of Southern California. It works to advance initiatives and experiences that strengthen community and enrich undergraduate life.

Branches and departments: Executive Branch (https://usg.usc.edu/executive-branch/); Legislative Branch (https://usg.usc.edu/legislative-branch/); Judicial Branch (https://usg.usc.edu/judicial-branch/); Communications (https://usg.usc.edu/branches/communications/); Funding (https://usg.usc.edu/branches/funding/); Programming (https://usg.usc.edu/branches/programming/), described as the umbrella organization for many other student organizations on campus; Advocacy (https://usg.usc.edu/branches/advocacy/).

Senate: The USG Senate meets in person every week to discuss current projects and ongoing policy implementation. Attendees can voice concerns during open forum. Online attendance is offered on Tuesdays via Zoom (https://usc.zoom.us/j/8741805668?omn=93347395088). Agendas and past minutes are in a shared Drive folder linked from the site. The page does not state the in-person meeting time or location.

Contact: USC Undergraduate Student Government, 3607 Trousdale Pkwy, SKS 404, Los Angeles, CA 90089. Email: usg@usc.edu. Contact form: https://usg.usc.edu/contact/. The office hours and staff roster is a linked Google Sheet.

Resources and involvement: https://usg.usc.edu/resources/ lists emergency contacts, financial support, advocacy and academic support, health and wellness support, and getting involved (https://usg.usc.edu/join/). Project Tracker: https://usg.usc.edu/legislative-branch/#projects. USG main calendar: http://usg.usc.edu/calendar. A newsletter signup form is linked. The Constitution, Bylaws and Brand Guidelines are linked from the site.
